Container.Name: spt-fika
Container.Overview: SPT server backend. Fika-compatible, but must be installed and configured. This is a barebones template to get your SPT/Fika server running quickly on Unraid.

Config.Name: Server User Directory
Config.Description: Location of user profiles, server mods (user/mods), and logs.

Config.Name: Web / Client Port
Config.Description: Host port for client HTTP traffic (used when running on bridge network).

Config.Name: Bind IP
Config.Description: Internal bind address inside the container.

Config.Name: SPT Port
Config.Description: Internal listening port for the SPT server.

Config.Name: Backend Advertised IP
Config.Description: Advertised LAN/remote IP address that game clients use to connect to this server.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file permissions (99 is Unraid 'nobody', 1000 for standard Linux user).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file permissions (100 is Unraid 'users', 1000 for standard Linux group).
